press_references.value: Banque Misr supports investors, farmers in 1.5 Million Feddan project

partnership_announcements.description: Banque Misr and Egyptian Countryside Development Company signed two cooperation protocols to finance SMEs and support Egyptians abroad investing in agricultural land under the 1.5 Million Feddan project, including the Your Farm in Egypt initiative.

press_references.value: Banque Misr funds Andalusia Hospital Maadi expansion with EGP 300m, $6.5m over 8 years

partnership_announcements.description: Banque Misr and Andalusia Health Group established a strategic financing partnership centered on Andalusia Hospital Maadi, with the bank providing long-term funding to support the group’s expansion of healthcare capacity in Egypt.

press_references.value: Egypt: Banque Misr signs protocol with GAHAR to finance medical facilities joining health insurance system

partnership_announcements.description: Banque Misr and the General Authority for Healthcare Accreditation and Regulation signed a new cooperation protocol to provide financing solutions, training, and development support for medical facilities seeking accreditation and inclusion in Egypt’s comprehensive health insurance system.

press_references.value: Banque Misr signs cooperation protocol with the official Egyptian real estate platform to enhance mortgage services

partnership_announcements.description: Banque Misr and E-systematic for Technology and Project Management, owner of The Official Egyptian Real Estate Platform, announced a strategic partnership to enhance mortgage services through the platform, aiming to improve customer access to mortgage financing and support Egypt's Vision 2030.

press_references.value: Banque Misr partners with MSMEDA in EGP 200m agreement to bolster small enterprises, expand working capital

partnership_announcements.description: Banque Misr has partnered with the Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprise Development Agency (MSMEDA) in a EGP 200 million agreement to support small enterprises and expand working capital. The partnership aims to provide loans at preferential interest rates to enhance production, boost income, and create job opportunities, with a focus on projects led by female entrepreneurs.

press_references.value: Banque Misr signs contract with MSMEDA to fund 3,000 micro-projects

partnership_announcements.description: The contract is valued at EGP 300m to fund 3,000 micro-projects, with 40% directed towards industrial projects, agricultural manufacturing, and related activities.

press_references.value: Banque Misr launches Egypt’s 1st digital property auction in collaboration with Belmazad

partnership_announcements.description: Banque Misr and Belmazad have partnered to launch Egypt's first digital property auction, advancing digital transformation in line with Egypt Vision 2030.
